control_labels: クイックスロット位置

test.title: Bottom Bar slider owns its complete visible thumb and reaches both endpoints by drag

contracts.gesture: pointer-drag 24 steps in both directions with exact endpoint readback

expected_region_changes.rule: moves from x=98 to x=570 and returns to x=98

test.title: every Basic Info page control declares and reaches its source-approved destination

scope: The source-visible Map button opens an inferred source-themed Map destination.
The source-visible Friend button activates the existing Party friends view.

contracts.gesture: pointer clicks every one of the eight declared Basic Info page controls

expected_region_changes.rule: each declared destination becomes visible and rises above Basic Info; friend also selects the Party friends view

invariant_regions.rule: Basic Info title and meter geometry plus bitmap authority remain unchanged after every destination click

test.title: every Basic Info resource slider declares and drives its independent visual thumb

contracts.gesture: pointer drag with 14 intermediate steps followed by keyboard Home and End for both HP and SP

expected_region_changes.rule: each independent visual thumb exposes more than four values and meets both exact source-track endpoints without a grey remainder

invariant_regions.rule: title, experience label, and footer geometry plus bitmap authority remain unchanged after both slider gestures

test.title: Basic Info minimize reaches its generated endpoint through more than four geometry steps and restores

scope: The source-visible minimize control transitions to the separately generated compact endpoint and restores the complete window.

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click minimizes, samples the complete transition, and pointer click restores

expected_region_changes.rule: the complete window exposes more than four geometry steps, settles at 180 by 18 with the generated endpoint, and restores to 280 by 120

invariant_regions.rule: title component geometry and bitmap authority remain unchanged in the compact endpoint

test.title: every source-visible Status increment owns its exact hitbox and changes only its local value field

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click on every one of the five source-visible 11 by 11 increment hitboxes

expected_region_changes.rule: each click changes only its local value field and exposes the matching semantic status

invariant_regions.rule: the clicked row label, complete derived column, and every other stat row remain pixel-identical

test.title: status minimize uses a generated compact endpoint through complete motion and restores the full source geometry

scope: The source-visible minimize control transitions to the separately generated compact endpoint and restores the complete Status window.

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click minimizes with complete transition sampling and a second pointer click restores

expected_region_changes.rule: more than four geometry steps settle at the generated 180 by 18 endpoint and restore to 280 by 126

invariant_regions.rule: title component geometry and bitmap authority remain unchanged in the compact endpoint

test.title: status close removes the window and Basic Info restores the same independent destination

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click closes Status and a trusted Basic Info status click restores it without reload

expected_region_changes.rule: the Status region is removed after close and becomes visible again through its source navigation control

invariant_regions.rule: the restored window has the exact pre-close geometry and ordered independent component inventory

test.title: every Inventory category is a reachable tab with its complete selectable cell inventory

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click activates each source-visible category tab and its labeled tabpanel

expected_region_changes.rule: selection transfers among all three tabs and exposes complete 21, 14, and 7 cell inventories

invariant_regions.rule: window title and scroll chrome remain independent and unchanged across tab visits

test.title: every reachable Inventory cell independently owns selection in all three categories

scope: Every visible source item cell is independently selectable in each category while preserving the Japanese source theme.

contracts.gesture: trusted pointer click visits every one of the 42 reachable cells across item, equip, and etc

expected_region_changes.rule: after each click exactly that one cell owns the selected state

invariant_regions.rule: no adjacent or prior cell retains semantic selection

test.title: Inventory real scroll gestures keep one visual thumb and every sampled body state below the header

contracts.gesture: keyboard Home, nine real vertical pointer positions, and keyboard End

expected_region_changes.rule: one independent thumb follows the exact 31 to 50 source endpoints while the clipped body exposes more than four states

invariant_regions.rule: the complete 263 by 18 header remains byte-identical at every sampled scroll value

expected_region_changes.rule: more than four geometry steps settle at 180 by 18 and restore exactly to 280 by 137
